decisions.text: Planner (ART-PLANNER-LEDGER): metrics review rvw_20261125T201839Z_65f73961; WORK ITEM codewalk-527-group3-plan; job key codewalk-527-group3-plan-20261125T201839Z-f84f; dir /home/ubuntu/MEGA/WORK/codewalk; eligible helpers (7): helperDeepSeek-41-flash-high, helperErnie-55-flash-high, helperGLM-53-high, helperGemini-4-argon-high, helperGemini-4-hydrogen-xhigh, helperGrok-47-high-F, helperHungerg-free (DeepSeek ok: Wed 20:18 UTC). Handshakes (job codewalk-527-group3-plan-20261125T201839Z-f84f): READY = helperDeepSeek-41-flash-high, helperGLM-53-high, helperGemini-4-argon-high, helperGemini-4-hydrogen-xhigh, helperGrok-47-high-F, helperHungerg-free. helperErnie-55-flash-high FAILED handshake twice (reasoning text leaked before READY, not exact) -> failed for this job, will be closed at end.

Draft assessment: #521 consensus: skip ShellRun + ToolCall kind shell in composerActivity, fall back to earlier activity or working/tip. #501 mic takes idle-check slot (GlobalKey reuse, slide, reduced motion snaps); continue/long-press unavailable while swapped. #502 drop live-waiting bar; pin open prompts (steer, queue, other clients) at timeline tail, weak fill + fade, commented Cancel; failed/uncertain rows stay above composer; send-now and tap-to-edit removed. Own finding: live order = stream order, steer sits mid-reply; reducer moves UserInput open->delivered to delivery position. #503: official resyncs on foreground only if quiet>=20s, CodeWalk always reconnects -> adopt; one 7s grace (hamburger too); grace sends held in outbox, posted once when live; picker enabled. Grok-F dissent D1-D3 pending.

ART-PLANNER-ASSESSMENT r1: Grok-F dissent: D3 agree; D1, D2 disagree, both resolved by evidence. D2: official reference reducer (plan/opencode-v2-src/client-solid-data.reference-reducer.ts:749-761) moves a delivered inbox row to the end, time.created=delivery; admission appends (375-398). So UI pins open prompts at tail and codewalk_core reducer moves UserInput open->delivered to delivery position (same stream). D1: official connection.ts keeps the stream on foreground when quiet<20s; server heartbeat 15s at v2.0.22 (server/src/handlers/event.ts:22). Mitigation: after a kept resume, watchdog deadline = lastByte+20s; route-change wake stays immediate; threshold is an SseRecoveryPolicy field set by the OpenCode adapter. Product calls (non-blocking, reported): #501 continue/long-press off while swapped; #502 send-now and tap-to-edit removed; one 7s grace incl. hamburger.

ART-EXECUTION-HANDOFF 1/2 (Ready). Order #521 -> #501 -> #502 -> #503, one review boundary each. #521 done in 26ccbeb7. #501: ComposerFrame gains a flag (mic takes the action slot); SessionComposer sets it when done (idle check) && mic enabled && (touch platform or compact <600dp); both rows; same _voice GlobalKey; slide ~200ms easeOutCubic, zero with disableAnimations; RTL directional; idle Send not built/hit-testable while swapped; draft page unchanged; tests composer_frame/composer widget; goldens via workflow. #502: remove live-waiting bar + _waiting; keep _row recovery rows; projection pins open prompts (UserInput accepted/queued + state.pending without resident row, this device and others) at timeline tail, hidden from their slot; pending bubble weak fill + breathing fade (static on reduced motion), semantics label, commented Cancel hook bottom-end with deliberate-decision comment; reducer moves UserInput open->delivered to delivery position; v2-native-check.

ART-EXECUTION-HANDOFF 2/2. #503: (a) codewalk_net SseRecoveryPolicy gains optional resumeQuiet; IoRecoveringSseConnection records last byte time; a resume wake keeps a connected stream heard within resumeQuiet and re-arms the watchdog at lastByte+resumeQuiet; route-change wake stays immediate (needs wake kind); OpenCode adapter sets 20s. (b) One 7s resume grace constant shared by hamburger/snackbar and composer, from health.resumedAt, only after a real background, only for views live before it, ended by confirmed Offline/auth/incompatible. (c) During grace: no connection label, editable field, attach/mic on, no hourglass, no recovery card, model/agent/variant chip usable (pick applies when live). (d) Sends during grace persist in the outbox, show as #502 pinned bubble, post once in order when live; after 7s still down, blocking UI returns and held sends wait. BEHAVIOR sections: live stream wake, status bar, server health, composer, model and agent.
